newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mustek to list on JSE in April.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mustek to list on JSE in April.

text.p: South African firm Mustek Ltd said on Wednesday that it aimed to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange by April 3.
Mustek is an investment firm which focuses on the information technology sector in three broad areas -- brand and channel distribution, the Mecer brand and new wave technologies.
The Mecer brand is the dominant brand in South African personal computers and laptop markets with a 15.8 percent market share.
Mustek said it had posted a year earnings per share to June 30, 1996, of 32.10 cents, up from 17.88 cents in the comparable period.
On February 21 South Africa's Baobab Solid Growth Ltd said on Friday that it had decided to distribute its entire interest in Mustek Ltd to its shareholders by way of a renounceable share offer.
